title: Discovering the neuronal dynamics in major depressive disorder using Hidden Markov Model
summary: The HMM-MAR model decoded resting- and task-state EEG dynamics from 53 participants (24 with major depressive disorder, 29 healthy controls). Its state time courses were related to PHQ-9 scores and differed between groups; this is an exploratory EEG association, not a validated diagnostic tool. The result remains bounded to the reported datasets and assays.
